title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Added Muna, Chusky's Monid-focused research specialist for qualified business leads, selected contact enrichment, local prospects, company briefs, audience insights, visibility comparisons, creator and video research, and review evidence.
Muna returns source-linked findings with exact verification states, sample coverage, uncertainty, and spend under Monid approval and budget controls.
Muna does not buy personal contact data, contact prospects, write CRM records, publish content, or create recurring monitoring; Monid remains disabled until configured and its terms are cleared.
